---
title: "How to show a survey 1 question at a time"
description: "Present your survey 1 question at a time, with a progress bar."
---

Present your survey 1 question at a time, with a progress bar.

The example in this guide is *Event feedback, one question at a time*. The event feedback survey shown one question at a time, for respondents on a phone.

## In SurveyStudio

1. In RStudio, open the **Addins** menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `conversational_survey`.
2. Open **Survey settings**. On **General**, set **Presentation mode** to Conversational: one question at a time.
3. On **Preview**, step through the questions with the Next button.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("conversational_survey")
d$instrument$render$mode     # "conversational"
export_survey(d$instrument, "survey.html")
```
